instructions: Assess each candidate for policy fidelity, numeric fidelity, source-supported claims, caveats, recipients, significance and next step. policy.text: For comparable weekly orders, notify the primary owner when total orders decline by 10% or more OR any region declines by 15% or more. Both total and regional populations must be comparable. An approved migration-freeze exception overrides those triggers and means ignore. If comparability is not established, send insufficient_data to the data owner.
